en.title: Malaysia Aviation Group Launches Pilot Drug Testing Following Detention
en.summary: Malaysia Aviation Group declared on August 6, 2026, that it has launched the first phase of mandatory drug screening for all pilots across its airlines, with plans to expand the testing to active cabin crew. The measure follows the arrest of a Malaysia Airlines second officer in Indonesia on drug trafficking allegations at Jakarta's Soekarno-Hatta International Airport. Meanwhile, the Civil Aviation Authority of Malaysia has opened a regulatory investigation to examine whether aviation security requirements were fully complied with before the pilot departed Kuala Lumpur International Airport. Airline officials noted that the off-duty pilot was traveling as an observer.
body: Malaysia Aviation Group (MAG) announced on August 6, 2026, that it has commenced the initial phase of mandatory drug screening for pilots across its subsidiary airlines, beginning with Malaysia Airlines. The company confirmed that the testing requirement will subsequently be expanded to include all active cabin crew members as part of enhanced operational safety measures.

The action follows allegations by Indonesian authorities that a Malaysia Airlines second officer arrived at Jakarta’s Soekarno-Hatta International Airport carrying approximately 25 kilograms of illicit substances in luggage. The Civil Aviation Authority of Malaysia has launched a regulatory investigation into pre-departure airport security compliance at Kuala Lumpur International Airport. The airline stated the off-duty pilot was seated as an observer, and the flight was safely operated by two qualified crew members.

DAE previously expanded its regional aircraft portfolio through the acquisition of Nordic Aviation Capital. Additionally, the company's fleet strategy focuses on narrowbody and single widebody models from Boeing and Airbus, alongside the ATR72-600 and factory fresh Boeing 777 freighters.

zh.title: 五角大廈報告揭露內部設計問題 波音新空軍一號計畫面臨延遲
zh.summary: 根據美國國防部於2026年8月3日發布的報告，波音為替換現行總統專機而研發的VC-25B新「空軍一號」因內部設計落後與技術認證問題，導致配線及結構修改工作延宕。波音在2026年第二季為此計畫增列2.8億美元虧損，仍預計於2028年交付首架飛機。
body: 根據美國國防部於2026年8月3日發布的預算報告，波音（Boeing）公司用以研發兩架全新「空軍一號」總統專機（美軍代號VC-25B，由波音747-8客機改裝）的計畫正遭遇更多延誤。報告指出，該機隊的內部設計因技術與認證問題仍落後於進度，導致配線設計、製造以及結構修改等工作皆受到波及。
報告顯示，艙內設計進度落後引發了「低效率的工程工作」，逼使波音必須對已開始改裝的部分機體進行重複修改。此外，兩架改裝飛機的結構縱樑（stringers）皆發現裂紋。截至2026年4月，首架飛機仍有95處維修或安裝待處理，第二架則有142處。該計畫同時面臨缺少合格的747-8駕駛艙擋風玻璃，以及客艙窗戶組件存在缺陷等問題。
儘管面臨多項考驗，波音於2026年7月表示仍預計在2028年交付首架VC-25B，第二架則預計於2029年交付。為了維持此一進度，波音已投入額外的生產與認證資源，並在2026年第二季為此計畫增列了2.8億美元的虧損。波音也與美國空軍達成協議，將該飛機的認證從原本的美國聯邦航空局（FAA）認證轉移為軍事認證程序，以降低試飛與認證階段的風險。
另外，根據本站統計紀錄，波音在2026年第二季的財務報告中，錄得單季營業收入246億美元，公認會計準則（GAAP）下每股虧損0.67美元，核心（非公認會計準則）每股虧損為0.76美元。美國空軍表示，現行的VC-25A總統專機將繼續維持運作，直到全新VC-25B能夠完全執行總統空運任務為止。

en.title: Pentagon Report Reveals Interior Design Issues Delaying Boeing's New Air Force One
en.summary: A Pentagon report released on August 3, 2026, reveals that Boeing's VC-25B cabin design is lagging due to technical and certification issues. These interior delays have affected wiring, fabrication, and structural work on the two modified 747-8 aircraft, leading to inefficient engineering. Despite registering an additional $280 million loss on the program in the second quarter, Boeing still expects to deliver the first aircraft in 2028. Additionally, the program is addressing structural stringer cracks, a windshield shortage, and window assembly issues.
body: According to a Pentagon report released on August 3, 2026, Boeing's efforts to develop two new Air Force One aircraft, officially designated as VC-25B, are facing further setbacks. The report, prepared as part of the Pentagon’s fiscal 2027 budget submission, indicates that the interior design for the modified Boeing 747-8 cabin continues to lag behind schedule due to unresolved technical and certification issues.

These cabin design delays have disrupted subsequent stages of the modification program, affecting wiring fabrication and structural work on both aircraft. This has led to "inefficient engineering work" and required Boeing to redo modifications on parts of the planes. Furthermore, structural stringer cracks on both aircraft require repairs; as of April 2026, 95 repairs remained on the first aircraft and 142 on the second. The program is also managing a shortage of certified cockpit windshields and window defect issues.

Despite these ongoing difficulties, Boeing stated in July 2026 that it still expects to deliver the first VC-25B in 2028, with the second planned for 2029. To protect this schedule, Boeing recorded an additional $280 million loss on the program during the second quarter of 2026. The manufacturer has also agreed with the U.S. Air Force to transition the aircraft from FAA certification to a military certification process to reduce risks during flight testing.

In addition, historical records from AVWIRE database show that Boeing recorded a total second-quarter revenue of $24.6 billion, with a GAAP loss per share of $0.67 and a core loss per share of $0.76. The U.S. Air Force plans to keep the current VC-25A fleet, which entered service in 1990, operational until the new VC-25B aircraft can fully carry out the presidential airlift mission.

body: 比利時已阻止愛爾蘭租賃公司GD Helicopter Finance（GDHF）收購位於奧斯坦德的直升機運營商NHV Group，GDHF最終由中國GDAT集團控制。
NHV於2026年8月5日確認，因比利時跨部門審查委員會（ISC）的決定，交易將不會繼續，公司所有權與控制權維持不變，仍由法國投資公司Ardian持有。
比利時自2023年7月1日起實施的外資審查機制，適用於非歐盟投資者取得能源、國防及關鍵基礎設施等敏感領域公司的控制權。
弗拉芒公共廣播機構VRT NWS於2026年2月7日報導，比利時軍事情報機構ADIV已接手審查，因NHV曾競標為比利時軍用直升機艦隊提供維護服務，官方擔憂收購完成後將無法執行該項工作。

en.summary: Belgium's Interfederal Screening Committee vetoed the acquisition of Ostend-based helicopter operator NHV Group by Irish lessor GD Helicopter Finance, which is ultimately controlled by China's GDAT Group; NHV confirmed the deal is terminated and ownership remains unchanged.
body: Belgium has blocked the acquisition of Ostend-based helicopter operator NHV Group by GD Helicopter Finance (GDHF), an Irish lessor ultimately controlled by Chinese interests.

NHV confirmed on August 5, 2026, that the deal would not proceed following a decision by Belgium’s Interfederal Screening Committee (ISC), and said there would be no change to its ownership or control, which remains with French private investment firm Ardian.

Belgium’s foreign investment screening mechanism, in force since July 1, 2023, applies to non-EU investors acquiring control of companies active in sensitive sectors including energy, defense and critical infrastructure.

VRT NWS reported on February 7, 2026, that Belgium’s military intelligence service, ADIV, had taken over the file; officials were concerned by the operator’s bid to maintain the Belgian military helicopter fleet.

body: 美國私募股權公司阿波羅全球管理公司（Apollo Global Management）已同意以大約57億英鎊（約合76億美元）的建議現金併購案收購易捷航空（easyJet）。根據公布的交易條款，每股易捷航空股票將由Eagle Bidco Ltd以7.15英鎊現金收購，該公司是由阿波羅資本管理公司旗下基金間接持有的澤西島註冊公司。
此併購案將透過2006年《公司法》第26條規定的法院批准計畫安排（scheme of arrangement）來實施。易捷航空董事會在接獲財務顧問Evercore的意見後表示，現金收購條款公平合理，董事會成員打算一致推薦股東投票贊成該計畫安排。

創辦人家族方面，由Sir Stelios、Clelia與Polys Haji-Ioannou以及easyGroup Holdings與easyGroup Ltd組成的哈吉-約安努家族（Haji-Ioannou）一致行動方，已不可撤銷地承諾就其持有的116,061,871股（約占已發行股本的15.31%）投票贊成該計畫安排。此外，持有427,767股（約占0.06%）的易捷航空董事也已做出投票承諾。
為符合歐盟航空公司所有權與控制權法規，交易設計了特定股權結構。阿波羅預計Topco將由展期股東持有45.1%至49.9%、歐盟信託持有最高5%，阿波羅基金持有不超過49.9%。相關章程亦包含加權投票、喪失表決權以及移除非歐盟籍董事等機制。
阿波羅已承諾，不會改變易捷航空英國總部的地點或職能，亦不會改變其在英國、奧地利與瑞士的航空營運人許可證（AOC）。該交易仍需取得股東批准、法院裁准、航空許可審查、多國合併控制與外國直接投資批准，預計交易將於2027年第一季末前完成。

en.title: Apollo Agrees £5.7 Billion Cash Takeover of easyJet
en.summary: Apollo Global Management has agreed to a recommended cash acquisition of easyJet valuing the airline at approximately £5.7 billion ($7.6 billion). Under the terms of the agreement, shareholders will receive £7.15 per share in cash via a court-approved scheme of arrangement. The board of directors of easyJet intends to unanimously recommend the offer following advice from Evercore that the terms are fair and reasonable. The Haji-Ioannou family concert party, holding approximately 15.31% of issued capital, has irrevocably committed to vote in favor of the scheme. The transaction remains subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals, with completion expected by the end of the first quarter of 2027.
body: Apollo Global Management has agreed to a recommended cash acquisition of easyJet valuing the airline at approximately £5.7 billion ($7.6 billion). Each easyJet share will be acquired for £7.15 in cash by Eagle Bidco Ltd, a Jersey-incorporated company indirectly owned by funds managed by affiliates of Apollo Capital Management. The acquisition price matches the figure Apollo indicated on July 10, 2026, following the decision by competing bidder Castlelake to refrain from making a bid.

The transaction will be implemented by a court-approved scheme of arrangement under Part 26 of the Companies Act 2006. Following advice from Evercore stating that the cash terms are fair and reasonable, the board of directors of easyJet intends to recommend the scheme unanimously to the airline’s shareholders.

The Haji-Ioannou family concert party—comprising Sir Stelios, Clelia, and Polys Haji-Ioannou along with entities including easyGroup Holdings and easyGroup Ltd—has irrevocably undertaken to vote for the scheme across 116,061,871 shares, amounting to approximately 15.31% of easyJet’s issued capital. Company directors holding 427,767 shares, representing about 0.06%, have also committed their shares in support of the transaction.

To maintain compliance with European Union airline ownership and control rules, the deal includes an ownership framework where Apollo expects Topco to be held by rollover shareholders at between 45.1% and 49.9%, an EU trust at up to 5%, and Apollo funds at no more than 49.9%. Provisions include weighted voting, disenfranchisement, and mechanisms to remove non-EU directors.

Apollo has committed to making no change to the location or functions of easyJet’s UK headquarters or its air operator certificates in the UK, Austria, and Switzerland. Completion remains subject to shareholder approval, court sanction, aviation license clearances, merger control in Austria, Egypt, Germany, and the UK, and foreign direct investment approvals, with completion targeted by the end of the first quarter of 2027.

en.title: Dubai Aerospace Enterprise Fleet to Exceed 1,000 Aircraft Following Acquisition
en.summary: Dubai Aerospace Enterprise currently manages a fleet of approximately 700 aircraft and has announced an agreement to acquire Macquarie AirFinance. Once the transaction closes, the lessor expects its total fleet to exceed 1,000 aircraft, enabling it to serve customers across 80 to 85 countries. Dubai Aerospace Enterprise generates around 85% of its business from aircraft leasing, with the remainder coming from airframe heavy maintenance services. The company's fleet strategy concentrates on narrowbody aircraft, one widebody model each from Boeing and Airbus, alongside ATR72-600 regional aircraft and Boeing 777 freighters.
body: According to AeroTime, Dubai Aerospace Enterprise Chief Executive Officer Firoz Tarapore stated that the company operates two primary business lines: aircraft leasing, which accounts for roughly 85% of its business, and airframe heavy maintenance services.

On the leasing side, Dubai Aerospace Enterprise currently manages a fleet of approximately 700 aircraft and has announced an agreement to acquire Macquarie AirFinance. Upon the closing of the transaction, the lessor's fleet will exceed 1,000 aircraft, expanding its service footprint to 80 to 85 countries.

Regarding fleet strategy, the firm focuses on narrowbody aircraft and one widebody product each from Boeing and Airbus. It also maintains significant positions in specialized types, including the ATR72-600 regional aircraft and Boeing 777 freighters, following its earlier acquisition of Nordic Aviation Capital in 2025.

zh.summary: 美國奧勒岡州德舒特郡警長辦公室表示，一名48歲飛行員於2026年8月4日駕駛西銳SR22T飛機，在空中盤旋超過五小時後，蓄意於偏遠林區墜毀身亡。該名飛行員在起飛當天早些時候，因涉嫌五項一級侵犯個人隱私重罪遭到起訴，FAA與NTSB已介入調查。
body: 美國奧勒岡州德舒特郡警長辦公室表示，一名48歲的飛行員於2026年8月4日蓄意將其駕駛的西銳SR22T單引擎飛機墜毀於一處偏遠林區。該名飛行員為唯一乘員並於墜機中身亡，地面無人受傷。
根據警方調查，該名駕駛Steven Nicholas Charlton於當天13時30分從本德市立機場起飛。在此之前，他因涉嫌五項一級侵犯個人隱私重罪遭到起訴。飛機在空中盤旋超過五小時後，於18時46分高速墜地，由於燃油耗盡並未起火。
美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）與國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）目前已針對此起墜機事件展開航空層面的調查，警長辦公室尚未透露Charlton在飛行期間與家屬或執法人員溝通的具體細節。

en.title: Oregon Pilot Deliberately Crashed Cirrus Plane After Five-Hour Flight, Authorities Say
en.summary: Authorities in Oregon have determined that a 48-year-old pilot intentionally crashed a Cirrus SR22T aircraft in a remote wooded area on August 4, 2026, after flying for over five hours. The pilot, Steven Nicholas Charlton, took off from Bend Municipal Airport and circled the area before crashing at high speed. Earlier that day, Charlton had been indicted on five felony counts of personal privacy invasion. The FAA and NTSB are investigating.
body: According to the Deschutes County Sheriff’s Office in Oregon, a 48-year-old pilot deliberately crashed a Cirrus SR22T aircraft in a remote wooded area on August 4, 2026. The pilot, identified as Steven Nicholas Charlton, was the only person on board and died in the high-speed crash. No ground injuries or property damage were reported.

Charlton took off from Bend Municipal Airport at approximately 13:30 local time. Earlier that day, he had been indicted on five felony counts of first-degree invasion of personal privacy. The aircraft remained airborne for over five hours, presumably running out of fuel before striking the ground.

Federal authorities, including the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) and the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB), are investigating the aviation aspects of the crash. Investigators are seeking witnesses who observed the flight or spoke with the pilot.

zh.title: 阿波羅以57億英鎊收購易捷航空達成協議
zh.summary: 英國廉價航空公司易捷航空證實，已與美國私募股權公司阿波羅達成57億英鎊的建議現金收購協議。隨著競爭對手Castlelake宣布無意提出更高出價，雙方董事會已就條款達成一致。交易預估將於明年第一季結束前完成，易捷航空總部將繼續維持設於盧頓鎮。
body: 英國廉價航空公司易捷航空正式證實，已與美國私募股權公司阿波羅達成收購協議。阿波羅將以57億英鎊（約新台幣2475億元）的金額達成這項收購案。主要經營歐洲區域航線的易捷航空透過官方聲明表示，雙方董事會非常高興地宣布，已經就建議之現金收購條款與相關條件正式達成協議。
根據易捷航空補充說明的交易時程，這筆收購案預計將於明年第一季結束前正式完成。在相關交易流程執行完畢後，易捷航空的總部將繼續留在盧頓鎮。盧頓鎮因鄰近倫敦的重要機場而聞名，該據點將持續作為易捷航空營運與管理的核心總部所在地。
在這項協議達成之前，競標對手美國投資集團Castlelake曾提出略高於50億英鎊的收購計畫。然而Castlelake表示無意提出更高的收購出價，在對手退出競標後，阿波羅順利入主易捷航空。易捷航空執行長賈維士今天對此表示，阿波羅在航空領域擁有的豐富經驗，使其成為易捷航空未來發展的強大合作夥伴。
除了收購消息之外，易捷航空近日也說明了其近期業績表現。受到中東局勢導致航空燃油價格飆升的影響，公司第三季淨利出現大幅下滑。在今年4月至6月期間，易捷航空的稅前盈餘比去年同期驟降70%，跌至8500萬英鎊。易捷航空是由企業家哈吉-約安努於1990年代創立，當時正值歐洲廉價航空業快速崛起時期。

en.title: Apollo Reaches Agreement to Acquire EasyJet for 5.7 Billion Pounds
en.summary: British low-cost carrier EasyJet has confirmed reaching an agreement on the terms of a recommended cash acquisition by US private equity firm Apollo, valuing the airline at 5.7 billion pounds. The deal follows rival investment group Castlelake confirming it would not submit a higher bid after previously offering over 5 billion pounds. Both boards have approved the agreed terms and conditions for the cash offer. The transaction is projected to close before the end of the first quarter of next year, and EasyJet will maintain its headquarters at Luton.
body: British low-cost carrier EasyJet has officially confirmed that US private equity firm Apollo has reached an agreement to acquire the airline for 5.7 billion pounds. EasyJet, which primarily operates routes across Europe, announced in a formal statement that the boards of both companies were pleased to confirm an agreement on the terms and conditions of the recommended cash acquisition.

According to details released by the airline, the transaction is expected to close before the end of the first quarter of next year. Following the completion of the acquisition, EasyJet will retain its corporate headquarters in Luton. The town, well known for its proximity to major London airport infrastructure, will continue to serve as the central location for the company's operations.

The agreement follows the decision by rival US investment group Castlelake to decline submitting a higher bid. Castlelake had previously presented an acquisition plan valued at slightly above 5 billion pounds before rival interest receded. Speaking on the deal, EasyJet Chief Executive Kenton Jarvis noted that Apollo's extensive background in the aviation sector makes it a strong partner for the airline.

Alongside the acquisition details, EasyJet also outlined its recent financial performance, noting that third-quarter net profit fell significantly due to surging aviation fuel costs driven by conflict in the Middle East. For the three-month period between April and June, pre-tax profit plunged 70 percent year-on-year to 85 million pounds. EasyJet was established in the 1990s by entrepreneur Stelios Haji-Ioannou during a period of rapid growth for European low-cost air travel.

zh.title: Apollo 同意以 57 億英鎊收購易捷航空 Castlelake 退出競標
zh.summary: Apollo Global Management 於2026年8月6日宣布，已就建議以現金收購易捷航空達成協議，對該航空公司估值約57億英鎊。Castlelake 在截止期限前數小時確認放棄競購。收購將透過法院批准的協議安排進行，每股易捷航空股份可獲7.15英鎊現金或選擇轉換為未上市的新控股公司股份。
body: Apollo Global Management 於2026年8月6日宣布，已就建議以現金收購易捷航空達成協議，對該航空公司估值約57億英鎊（約76億美元）。此公告發布於原競購截止日前一天，數小時前 Castlelake 確認不會參與競標。
根據協議，由 Apollo Capital Management 附屬基金間接擁有的澤西島註冊公司 Eagle Bidco Ltd 將以每股7.15英鎊現金收購 easyJet 股份。此價格與 Apollo 於2026年7月10日提出的指示性價格相符，並將透過2006年公司法第26部規定的法院批准協議安排實施。
此報價較 easyJet 每股3.94英鎊的未受影響收市價溢價81%，並較中東衝突爆發前的最後一個交易日2026年2月27日收市價4.64英鎊溢價54%。股東可選擇以所持每股 easyJet 股份換取一股未上市 Topco 股份，惟此選擇設有上限，合計不得超過 Topco 已發行普通股本的49.9%。
Haji-Ioannou 家族一致行動人士已不可撤銷地承諾投票支持該安排並選擇轉換股份，涉及約佔已發行股本15.31%的116,061,871股股份。持有427,767股（約0.06%）的董事亦已作出相同承諾。
Apollo 預計 Topco 將由選擇轉換股份的股東持有45.1%至49.9%，歐盟信託持有最多5%，而 Apollo 基金則持有不超過49.9%。相關架構設有國籍聲明、加權投票及剝奪投票權等機制，以確保遵守歐盟航空公司所有權與控制權規則。
該交易須經股東批准、法院認可、航空執照審批、奧地利、埃及、德國及英國的合併控制審查，以及多個國家的外國直接投資審批。協議文件預計於28日內發布，交易可望於2027年第一季底前完成。

en.title: Apollo agrees £5.7 billion takeover of easyJet as Castlelake walks away
en.summary: Apollo Global Management announced a recommended cash acquisition of easyJet on August 6, 2026, valuing the airline at approximately £5.7 billion. Castlelake confirmed it would not bid earlier the same day. The deal will be implemented via a court-approved scheme, offering £7.15 per easyJet share in cash or an option for unlisted rollover shares.
body: Apollo Global Management announced a recommended cash acquisition of easyJet on August 6, 2026, valuing the airline at approximately £5.7 billion ($7.6 billion). The announcement was published a day before the deadline both bidders faced and hours after Castlelake confirmed it would not bid.

Under the terms, each easyJet share will be acquired for £7.15 in cash by Eagle Bidco Ltd, a Jersey-incorporated company indirectly owned by funds managed by affiliates of Apollo Capital Management. The price matches the figure Apollo indicated on July 10, 2026. The deal will be implemented by a court-approved scheme of arrangement under Part 26 of the Companies Act 2006.

The price represents an 81% premium to the unaffected closing price of £3.94, and a 54% premium to the £4.64 close on February 27, 2026, the last business day before the Middle East conflict began. Shareholders may instead elect unlisted rollover shares in Topco, one per easyJet share, capped at 49.9% of Topco's issued ordinary share capital.

The Haji-Ioannou family concert party, holding approximately 15.31% of issued capital, has irrevocably undertaken to vote for the scheme and elect the rollover for all 116,061,871 shares. Directors holding 427,767 shares, about 0.06%, have also committed.

Apollo expects Topco to be held by rollover shareholders at between 45.1% and 49.9%, an EU trust at up to 5%, and the Apollo funds at no more than 49.9%. The structure includes nationality declarations and weighted voting provisions to remain inside EU airline ownership and control rules.

Completion requires shareholder approval, court sanction, aviation license clearances, merger control in Austria, Egypt, Germany and the UK, and foreign direct investment approvals in multiple countries. The scheme document is due within 28 days, with completion expected by the end of the first quarter of 2027.

zh.summary: 巴哈馬空中航行服務局（BANSA）已開始向自2021年5月1日起在該國領空內或其境內進行飛行之雙引擎活塞式、渦輪螺旋槳及噴射機營運商，追溯徵收航行費。根據美國國家通用航空協會（NBAA）指出，部分費用漲幅達300%至700%。
body: 巴哈馬空中航行服務局（BANSA）已開始向自2021年5月1日起，在巴哈馬境內、境內或其領空內進行飛行之雙引擎活塞式、渦輪螺旋槳及噴射機營運商，追溯徵收航行費。
根據美國國家通用航空協會（NBAA）指出，這些費用的漲幅視飛機最大起飛重量而定，漲幅介於近300%至近700%之間。
此項追溯徵收政策適用於私人及商業飛行，但單引擎活塞式飛機、搜救任務、緊急醫療飛行、特定緊急著陸以及政府或軍用飛機則獲得豁免。
NBAA 表示，該協會正與其他受影響的利害關係人及美國政府合作，針對此項費用可能對 FBO、機場、旅遊業及相關企業造成的負面經濟影響展開倡議工作。

en.title: The Bahamas imposes retroactive navigation fees dating back to 2021
en.summary: The Bahamas Air Navigation Services Authority (BANSA) has begun collecting retroactive navigation fees from operators of twin-engine piston, turboprop, and jet aircraft that flew to, from, within, or over the country since May 1, 2021. According to the NBAA, fee increases range from nearly 300% to almost 700%.
body: The Bahamas Air Navigation Services Authority (BANSA) has begun collecting retroactive navigation fees from operators that flew to, from, within or over the country in piston twins, turboprops and jets since May 1, 2021.
The National Business Aviation Association (NBAA) stated that the increases range from nearly 300% to almost 700%, depending on the aircraft’s maximum takeoff weight.

The charges apply to both private and commercial flights, though exemptions are provided for single-engine piston aircraft, search-and-rescue missions, emergency medical flights, certain emergency landings, and government or military aircraft.

The NBAA is launching an advocacy effort with other impacted stakeholders and the US government to highlight the negative economic impact such fees may have on FBOs, airports, the travel industry, and surrounding businesses.

IndiGo 將孟買至阿姆斯特丹航線於 10 月 25 日改用空中巴士 A321XLR，倫敦希思路航線則暫停，直至該航空開始接收空中巴士 A350-900。IndiGo 自 2025 年起向 Norse 接收六架 787，作為未來 A350 機隊到達前的過渡安排。
Norse 執行長 Eivind Roald 表示，中東衝突導致的燃油價格上漲、空域中斷及更長的飛行路線，已影響該安排的商業可行性。雙方共同得出結論，認為飛機的替代部署對雙方在商業上更為有利。
Norse 表示已在與數家航空公司洽談，以機組、維護與保險協議方式安置最多五架飛機，並計劃將部分運力用於自身冬季航線，包括從歐洲飛往奧蘭多與紐約的額外航班。Norse 營運共 12 架波音 787-9。
Norse 的董事會已啟動正式程序，可能導致出售、合併或合作。該航空未透露任何潛在買家或合作對象，也未說明程序何時結束。此前媒體報導，Norse 曾聘請 JPMorgan 進行策略性評估。
Norse 同時在削減成本與籌集資金。2026 年 4 月，Norse 宣布透過配股籌集 1.1 億美元，並安排了 7,000 萬美元的過橋貸款。其 Project Falcon 成本削減計畫目標為每年節省最多 5,000 萬美元。

en.title: Norse Atlantic begins formal sale process as IndiGo returns six Boeing 787s early
en.summary: IndiGo will discontinue widebody operations on October 25, 2026 and end its lease of six Boeing 787-9s from Norse Atlantic Airways on October 31, citing geopolitical tensions. Norse has begun a formal process that may result in a sale, merger or partnership, and is in talks with several airlines about new ACMI placements.
body: Norse Atlantic Airways is seeking new work for six Boeing 787-9s after IndiGo agreed to return the aircraft early. IndiGo said it will discontinue its widebody operations on October 25, 2026, and conclude its lease agreement with Norse on October 31.

IndiGo's Mumbai-Amsterdam route will switch to the Airbus A321XLR on October 25, while service to London Heathrow will be suspended until the airline begins receiving its Airbus A350-900s. IndiGo began taking the six Dreamliners from Norse in 2025 as a bridge to its future A350 fleet.

Norse CEO Eivind Roald said elevated fuel prices, airspace disruptions and longer flight routes resulting from the Middle East conflict had affected the commercial viability of the arrangement. The two parties jointly concluded that alternative deployment would be more commercially beneficial.

Norse said it is already speaking with several airlines about placing up to five aircraft under new aircraft, crew, maintenance and insurance agreements. The carrier also plans to use some returning capacity on its own network during winter, including additional flights from Europe to Orlando and New York. Norse operates a total of 12 Boeing 787-9s.

Norse's board has begun a formal process that may result in a sale, merger or partnership. The airline has not identified any potential buyer or partner or said when the process might end. Norse previously hired JPMorgan to conduct a strategic review after receiving interest from potential partners, according to media reports.

The airline has also been cutting costs and raising money. In April, Norse announced plans to raise $110 million through a rights issue and arranged a $70 million bridge loan. Its Project Falcon cost-cutting program is targeting annual savings of up to $50 million.

zh.summary: 2026年8月3日，一架飛教練與學生乘坐的Piper PA-28-151 Cherokee Warrior因引擎油壓降至紅色區域而在佛州彭薩科拉州際10號高速公路上緊急迫降。飛機在高速公路上安全停止，未撞擊任何車輛，兩人無傷。FAA已確認飛員回報油壓問題並展開調查。
body: 根據AeroTime報導，飛教練Emily Shelton在學生的第一堂飛行課中發現引擎油壓急速下降，隨即向空中交通管制宣布緊急狀況。
她最初嘗試返回彭薩科拉國際機場，但判斷無法抵達，因而將飛機引導至州際10號高速公路上，並在卡車司機Eric Jordan的行車記錄器畫面中穿過車輛與 overhead 高速標誌之間的縫隙後著陸。
飛機在高速公路上中心附近觸地，保持控制並平緩滑行停止，未碰到任何車輛。Shelton稱她曾訓練過類似情況，並在事故前已累積約1300飛行時數。FAA證實飛員回報油壓問題，但未公開具體機械故障細節，調查仍在進行中。

en.title: Flight instructor guides student Piper to emergency landing on Florida Interstate 10
en.summary: On August 3, 2026, a flight instructor and her student made an emergency landing of a Piper PA-28-151 Cherokee Warrior on Interstate 10 near Pensacola, Florida after the engine oil pressure dropped into the red. The aircraft landed safely on the highway, avoided vehicles, and came to a stop without injuries to the two occupants. The FAA has confirmed the oil-pressure report and opened an investigation.
body: According to AeroTime, flight instructor Emily Shelton was conducting a student's first lesson when she observed the oil pressure falling into the red zone and fumes from burning oil entering the cockpit.

She initially tried to return to Pensacola International Airport but determined the aircraft would not reach the airport, so she guided the Piper onto the highway, steering between moving vehicles and under an overhead sign as captured in a truck driver's dashcam video.

The aircraft touched down near the center of the highway, remained under control, rolled to a stop without striking any vehicles, and both occupants were uninjured. Shelton said her training had prepared her for such an emergency and she had logged about 1,300 flight hours prior to the incident. The FAA confirmed the oil-pressure announcement but has not released further mechanical details while the investigation continues.

en.title: FAA Investigates Marine One Safety Incident Involving Trump Flight
en.summary: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is investigating an August 4 safety incident involving a Marine One helicopter carrying US President Donald Trump near Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport. According to sources, the helicopter and an Embraer E175 operated by Envoy Air on behalf of American Airlines did not maintain the required Class B airspace separation of at least 1.5 nautical miles or 500 feet. However, the FAA stated that the situation did not appear to be a dangerous close call and the aircraft were not converging.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) is investigating an August 4, 2026, safety incident involving a Marine One helicopter carrying US President Donald Trump near Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport.

According to sources cited by Reuters, the incident involved an Embraer E175 operated by Envoy Air on behalf of American Airlines. The aircraft and Marine One reportedly failed to maintain the required separation of at least 1.5 nautical miles or 500 feet in Class B airspace.

The Wall Street Journal reported that air traffic controllers did not hold commercial flights as required under protocols. However, the FAA stated that the event did not appear to be a dangerous close call and that the aircraft were not converging.

zh.title: 萊比錫機場因疑似爆裂物與空中相撞暫停運作
zh.summary: 萊比錫/哈勒機場因不明飛行物與南跑道可疑物品，於8月4日晚至5日凌晨暫停部分運作；馬拉布航空客機轉降紐倫堡；DHL貨機疑與無人機相撞轉降漢諾威，警方調查中。
body: 萊比錫/哈勒機場（LEJ）於2026年8月4日晚至5日凌晨因不明飛行物與南跑道可疑物品，部分暫停飛行作業。萊比錫警方表示，接獲通報後採取行動，導致多架航班轉降，包括馬拉布航空DI6777班機（空中巴士A320neo，自馬洛卡島馬爾馬）轉往紐倫堡機場。
警方於當地時間23時40分左右首次發現不明飛行物，稍後在南跑道尋獲一物品，聯邦警察以排爆機械人檢查。北跑道於8月5日01時55分恢復運作，南跑道因調查持續關閉。
另據路透社引述消息人士，一架DHL營運的貨機在萊比錫機場附近與不明物體相撞，緊急轉降漢諾威。DHL集團執行長托比亞斯·梅耶爾在8月5日的Q2投資人電話會議中表示，公司有應變計劃，將儘量減少對客戶影響。
飛行追蹤數據Flightradar24顯示，受損機體可能為EAT萊比錫營運的空中巴士A300貨機（註冊D-AZML），執行BCS7JG班機自馬德里起飛。德媒報導碰撞發生於機場約6公里、高度400公尺處，機鼻輕微受損。

下薩克森警方將事件列為國家安全罪行，未排除破壞行為。《圖片報》引述安全消息稱，物品為攜帶引爆裝置包裹的無人機，發現於停放的安托諾夫航空An-124貨機附近。調查人員視為可能爆裂裝置，截至8月5日下午尚不清楚是否已進行受控引爆。安托諾夫航空因2022年霍斯托梅爾機場戰損，將大部分An-124機隊遷至萊比錫。此事件加入近期歐洲軍事設施、能源終端、海港及物流樞紐遭未授權無人機干擾的系列案件，多國警方疑涉俄羅斯代理人，莫斯科否認。國際戰略研究所（IISS）評估，俄羅斯關聯無人機活動過去18個月迫使慕尼黑、哥本哈根、維爾紐斯等主要樞紐關閉。萊比錫作為德國第二大貨運機場及DHL樞紐，2024年曾發生陰謀在過境包裹置放燃燒裝置，目前仍在德刑事審理中。

en.title: Leipzig airport operations disrupted by suspected explosive device and mid-air collision
en.summary: Leipzig/Halle Airport partially suspended flight operations overnight August 4-5 after police responded to an unidentified flying object and a suspicious item near the south runway. A Marabu Airlines A320neo diverted to Nuremberg. Separately, a DHL-operated cargo aircraft collided with an unidentified object near Leipzig and diverted to Hanover for an emergency landing. Flightradar24 data suggests the aircraft may be an EAT Leipzig Airbus A300 freighter. Police in Lower Saxony classified the incident as a state security offense and have not ruled out sabotage. Investigations are ongoing.
body: Leipzig/Halle Airport (LEJ) partially suspended flight operations overnight from August 4 to August 5, 2026, after police responded to reports of an unidentified flying object and a suspicious item near the south runway. The Leipzig police directorate said the flying object was first sighted around 23:40 local time on August 4, prompting several aircraft to divert, including Marabu Airlines flight DI6777, an Airbus A320neo arriving from Palma de Mallorca, which was diverted to Nuremberg Airport.

Officers later found an object near the south runway, which federal police examined using a bomb disposal robot. Flight operations resumed on the north runway at 01:55 on August 5, though the south runway remained closed as investigations continued.

Separately, a DHL-operated cargo aircraft collided with an unidentified object near Leipzig airport and diverted for an emergency landing in Hanover, Reuters reported citing a source familiar with the incident. DHL Group CEO Tobias Meyer stated during the company's Q2 2026 investor call on August 5 that the company has plans for such cases and will try to minimize customer impact.

Flightradar24 data indicates the damaged aircraft may have been an EAT Leipzig Airbus A300 freighter registered D-AZML operating flight BCS7JG from Madrid. German media reported the collision occurred roughly six kilometers from the airport at an altitude of about 400 meters, with the aircraft sustaining minor damage to its nose section.

Police in Lower Saxony classified the incident as a state security offense and have not ruled out sabotage. Bild, citing security sources, reported the object was a drone carrying a package fitted with a detonator, found close to a parked Antonov Airlines An-124 freighter. Investigators were treating the find as a possible explosive device, though it remained unclear by the afternoon of August 5 whether a controlled detonation had been carried out. Antonov Airlines relocated most of its An-124 fleet to Leipzig/Halle after fighting at Hostomel Airport near Kyiv in 2022 devastated its home base. The incident adds to a string of unauthorized drone sightings disrupting European military sites, energy terminals, seaports, and logistics hubs, which several police forces have said could involve Russian agents, an allegation Moscow denies. A recent IISS assessment found Russian-linked drone activity forced closures at major European hubs including Munich, Copenhagen, and Vilnius over the past 18 months. Leipzig/Halle, Germany's second-largest cargo airport and a major DHL hub, has featured in security investigations before: a 2024 plot to plant incendiary devices in packages transiting through the airport remains the subject of an ongoing criminal trial in Germany.

zh.summary: 美國聯邦航空總署核發波音737 MAX 7的修改型別檢定證與生產限制紀錄。波音依規定完成飛行控制軟體、機組員警報系統及引擎防冰系統改善。FAA安全檢查員將持續駐廠監控製造過程。
body: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）於2026年8月3日宣布，已核發波音737 MAX 7的修改型別檢定證與更新的生產限制紀錄。該項認證確認該型客機符合所有適用之設計與安全法規，並授權波音開始生產該機型。
在核準前，FAA要求波音進行多項關鍵改進，包括更新飛行控制軟體、機組員警報系統，以及重新設計引擎防冰系統，以防止引擎進氣口過熱並強化相關結構。波音民用飛機集團總裁兼執行長 Stephanie Pope 表示，此認證驗證了飛機設計的嚴謹性。
FAA補充說明，安全檢查員將持續駐紮於全美各地的波音生產設施，以密切監控製造過程與安全管理系統。歷史資料顯示，截至2026年7月，波音已完成737-7的認證飛行測試。

en.title: FAA Grants Certification for Boeing 737 MAX 7 Commercial Service
en.summary: The US Federal Aviation Administration has issued an amended type certificate and Production Limitation Record for the Boeing 737 MAX 7. Before granting approval, the regulatory agency required Boeing to incorporate key safety improvements, including updates to flight-control software, flightcrew alerting systems, and a redesigned engine anti-ice system. Boeing Commercial Airplanes leadership stated that the certification validates the aircraft's design. Federal Aviation Administration safety inspectors will remain on site at Boeing manufacturing facilities to monitor ongoing production processes.
body: The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) issued an amended type certificate and updated Production Limitation Record for the Boeing 737 MAX 7 on August 3, 2026. The approval authorizes Boeing to begin production of the commercial aircraft model following regulatory review.

Prior to granting certification, the FAA required Boeing to incorporate key safety improvements, including updates to flight-control software, flightcrew alerting systems, and a redesigned engine anti-ice system. Boeing Commercial Airplanes President and CEO Stephanie Pope stated that the certification validates the rigor of the airplane's design.

The FAA stated that its safety inspectors will remain present at Boeing manufacturing facilities across the country to closely monitor production processes. Historical records indicate that Boeing had completed certification flight testing on the 737-7 variant by July 2026.

en.title: Colombia signs contract for two Embraer KC-390 Millennium airlifters
en.summary: Embraer announced on 4 August 2026 that the Colombian Aerospace Force has signed a $366.4 million fixed‑price contract for two KC-390 Millennium multi‑mission aircraft. Deliveries are scheduled for 2029 and 2030, with the first aircraft ferried from Embraer’s Gavião Peixoto plant to CATAM air base in Bogotá. The purchase supports the force’s heavy tactical transport requirement under its 2042 Air and Space Development Strategy and the jets will be equipped to operate alongside the 17 Gripen E/F fighters ordered from Saab.
body: Embraer announced on 4 August 2026 that the Colombian Aerospace Force (FAC) has signed a contract for two KC-390 Millennium multi‑mission aircraft.

The contract is valued at $366.4 million at fixed prices, spread over four years, covering the aircraft, mission equipment, initial training, ground support equipment and 24 months of integrated logistics support.
Deliveries are planned for 2029 and 2030, with the first aircraft to be ferried from Embraer’s Gavião Peixoto plant to CATAM air base in Bogotá.
The acquisition falls under the FAC’s heavy tactical military transport requirement, part of its Air and Space Development Strategy 2042 (EDAES 2042) formulated in 2019.

The KC-390s will be delivered with connectivity to operate alongside the 17 Gripen E/F fighters Colombia ordered from Saab in November 2025, and can be fitted with removable air‑to‑air refuelling equipment to serve as tanker or receiver.

en.title: Silk Way West 747-8 Diverts to Dallas and Declares Fuel Emergency
en.summary: According to news coverage published by Simple Flying, a Silk Way West Boeing 747-8 flight did not land at its intended destination of Houston and instead continued on to Dallas. The aircraft reached Dallas with approximately 30 minutes of fuel remaining in its tanks. Due to the limited fuel endurance remaining upon arrival in Dallas, an emergency declaration was made for the 747-8 flight. The situation involved a diversion from Houston to Dallas.
body: According to news reporting published by Simple Flying on August 4, 2026, a Silk Way West Boeing 747-8 aircraft flew past its original intended destination of Houston and instead continued its flight path to Dallas.

The 747-8 flight reached Dallas with only 30 minutes of fuel remaining in its tanks. Due to the critical low-fuel condition upon arrival in the Dallas airspace, an emergency was subsequently declared for the aircraft.
As of publication, official authorities have not released detailed findings or investigation reports regarding the circumstances behind the route change and the low-fuel emergency declaration.

body: 美國海軍陸戰隊一架F-35B戰鬥機於2026年7月31日在加州聖地牙哥的米拉瑪航空基地跑道附近墜毀。根據軍方說明，這架戰機隸屬於第三海軍陸戰航空聯隊第11航空大隊，事發時間大約在當地時間上午10時左右，緊急救援人員隨即抵達現場處置。

en.title: US Marine Corps F-35B Crashes at MCAS Miramar, Pilot Survives Ejection
en.summary: A US Marine Corps F-35B fighter jet crashed near the runway at Marine Corps Air Station Miramar in San Diego on July 31, 2026. According to military officials, the pilot was the only person on board and survived after ejecting from the aircraft. The pilot was transported to a local medical facility in stable condition with non-life-threatening injuries. The Marine Corps has classified the crash as a Class A mishap, which is its most serious accident category. While witnesses reported the pilot ejected at approximately 100 feet, officials have not confirmed the aircraft's altitude, flight profile, or whether a vertical landing was being conducted.
body: A US Marine Corps F-35B fighter jet crashed near the runway at Marine Corps Air Station Miramar in San Diego on July 31, 2026. The aircraft was assigned to Marine Aircraft Group 11 of the 3rd Marine Aircraft Wing. Emergency crews responded at approximately 10:00 local time.

The pilot, the only occupant, survived a low-altitude ejection and was taken to a local hospital in stable condition with non-life-threatening injuries. The Marine Corps has classified the crash as a Class A mishap, which represents its most serious accident category.
A witness told the Associated Press that the pilot ejected at about 100 feet. The Marine Corps has not confirmed the aircraft's altitude or flight profile.

en.title: US FAA Grants Type Certification for Boeing 737 MAX 7
en.summary: The US Federal Aviation Administration issued an amended type certificate and updated Production Limitation Record for the Boeing 737 MAX 7 on August 3, 2026. The approval follows years of technical evaluation and requires key aircraft improvements, including updates to the flight-control software, the flightcrew alerting system, and a redesigned engine anti-ice system. Southwest Airlines remains the largest customer for the narrowbody variant, with more than 300 aircraft on order. Earlier in July 2026, Boeing completed certification flight testing on both the 737-7 and 737-10 variants.
body: The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) issued an amended type certificate and updated Production Limitation Record for the Boeing 737 MAX 7 on August 3, 2026, marking the completion of an extensive regulatory review process.

Prior to granting certification, the FAA required Boeing to incorporate key safety improvements into the aircraft. These technical updates include modifications to the flight-control software, the flightcrew alerting system, and a redesigned engine anti-ice system.

Southwest Airlines is the largest customer for the variant, with an order book exceeding 300 Boeing 737 MAX 7 aircraft. In historical records, Boeing confirmed that certification flight testing for both the 737-7 and 737-10 variants was completed as of July 2026.

zh.title: 澳洲航空與日本航空簽署協議重組捷星日本股權
zh.summary: 澳洲航空集團與日本航空於2026年8月4日宣布簽署具約束力協議，透過由捷星日本自身執行的股份回購交易改變股權結構。Development Bank of Japan將成為新股東，東京世紀與日本航空保留現有持股，澳洲航空將完全出脫其33.32%少數股權。交易金額約84億日圓，預計2027年6月前完成，仍待監管機關核准。
body: 澳洲航空集團與日本航空於2026年8月4日宣布，雙方已簽署一項具約束力的協議，將改變捷星日本的股權結構。此計畫最早於2026年2月提出，目前確認將透過由捷星日本自身執行的股份回購交易來進行，但交易仍需取得監管機關核准後方能完成。
在新架構下，Development Bank of Japan將成為捷星日本的新股東，而Tokyo Century Corporation與日本航空將保留其現有持股。澳洲航空集團則將完全退出，透過由捷星日本自身執行的回購出售其持有的33.32%少數股權。整項轉換預計於2027年6月前完成。
對澳洲航空集團而言，此舉可釋出資金，計畫用於重新投入其在澳洲的國內與國際航線營運，而非繼續持有日本航空公司的少數股權。此交易也使捷星日本轉向以日資為主的股權結構，由日本企業持有該航空公司股份。
澳洲航空退出後，捷星日本計畫不再使用「Jetstar」名稱，將以全新品牌身分繼續以低成本航空公司身分在日本營運。雙方表示，此交易不影響旅客現有航班的正常營運，澳洲航空與捷星往返澳洲與日本的國際航班將照常運作，與日本航空的共用班號安排也維持不變。
股份回購交易金額為84億日圓（約5,500萬美元）。對澳洲航空集團而言，預計將產生約1.15億澳幣（約7,500萬美元）的帳外收益，主要反映於其2027會計年度帳目中。在交易完成前，澳洲航空將繼續將捷星日本的損益份額計入其基礎稅前盈餘。

en.title: Qantas Group and Japan Airlines Sign Binding Deal to Reshape Jetstar Japan Ownership
en.summary: Qantas Group and Japan Airlines announced on August 4, 2026 that they have signed a binding agreement to restructure Jetstar Japan's ownership through a share buyback. Development Bank of Japan will join as a new shareholder, while Tokyo Century Corporation and JAL retain their existing stakes. Qantas Group will fully exit its 33.32% minority stake. The transaction is valued at JPY 8.2 billion (US$55 million) and is expected to be completed by June 2027, pending regulatory approval.
body: Qantas Group and Japan Airlines announced on August 4, 2026 that they have signed a binding agreement to change the ownership structure of Jetstar Japan, moving forward with a plan first floated in February 2026. The deal confirms a share buyback transaction, though it still requires regulatory approval before completion.

Under the new structure, Development Bank of Japan will come in as a new shareholder in Jetstar Japan, while Tokyo Century Corporation and JAL will keep their existing stakes. Qantas Group will exit entirely, selling its 33.32% minority stake through a buyback carried out by Jetstar Japan itself. The transition is expected to wrap up by June 2027.

For Qantas Group, the move frees up capital that it plans to redirect toward its own domestic and international operations in Australia. The deal also shifts Jetstar Japan toward a more Japan-based ownership structure, with Japanese companies holding the airline's shares.

Once Qantas exits, Jetstar Japan plans to move away from the Jetstar name altogether, rebranding under a new identity while continuing to operate as a low-cost carrier in Japan. The airlines stated that existing operations for travelers remain unaffected, with Qantas and Jetstar international flights between Australia and Japan continuing as normal and codeshare arrangements with JAL unchanged.

The share buyback transaction is valued at JPY 8.2 billion (US$55 million). For Qantas Group, the deal is expected to result in a gain of roughly AU$115 million (US$75 million) in items outside its underlying financial results, with most of the impact showing up in its FY27 accounts. Until the deal is finalized, Qantas will continue to include its share of Jetstar Japan's profits or losses in its underlying pre-tax earnings.

zh.title: 美國FAA正式核發波音737 MAX 7修改後型別認證
zh.summary: 美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）於2026年8月3日正式對波音737 MAX 7核發修改後的型別認證與更新的生產限制紀錄。在此之前，FAA要求該機型必須進行多項關鍵改進，包括飛行控制軟體更新、機組員警示系統優化以及重新設計的引擎防冰系統。該機型先前為MAX家族中最後兩款等待認證的衍生機型之一。
body: 美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）於2026年8月3日正式對波音（Boeing）737 MAX-7客機核發修改後的型別認證，並更新其生產限制紀錄。此項決定代表了雙方歷經將近十年的廣泛審查、解決複雜技術問題並完成詳細安全分析後的重要進展。FAA表示，此項認證確認該款飛機符合所有適用的設計與安全標準，而更新後的生產限制紀錄也正式授權波音開始量產此款機型。
在正式授予此項核准之前，FAA要求波音737 MAX-7必須納入多項關鍵改進措施，以符合《飛機認證、安全與問責法》之規定及美國國家運輸安全委員會（NTSB）的建議。這些關鍵改進包括飛行控制軟體的更新、機組員警示系統的優化，以及重新設計的引擎防冰系統。新系統的設計目的在於提供飛行員更清晰的資訊與警告，並防止引擎進氣口過熱而可能削弱周邊結構的風險。
儘管認證已經核發，FAA表示其安全監察員仍將繼續派駐於波音位於全美各地的生產工廠，密切監督整個製造過程，並對波音的安全管理系統（SMS）以及安全文化進行觀察與評估。

根據 Simple Flying 報導，737 MAX-7 與 MAX-10 是波音 737 MAX 家族中最後兩款等待認證的衍生機型。先前歷史資料顯示，這款最小型的 MAX 衍生機型受到許多客戶高度關注，例如西南航空（Southwest Airlines）其整個商業模式都圍繞著單一機型機隊運作，因而一直在等待該機型的交付。隨著 MAX-7 順利取得 FAA 認證，這款飛機將能推進後續的量產與交付時程。

en.title: FAA Grants Amended Type Certification to Boeing 737 MAX 7
en.summary: The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) on August 3, 2026, officially issued an amended type certificate and updated Production Limitation Record for the Boeing 737 MAX-7. To secure this approval, the aircraft was required to incorporate major improvements, including flight-control software updates, flightcrew alerting enhancements, and a redesigned engine anti-ice system. FAA inspectors will remain on site at Boeing facilities to monitor production. The MAX 7, alongside the MAX 10, had been one of the final two variants in the MAX family awaiting certification, a milestone long awaited by customers such as Southwest Airlines.
body: The United States Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) announced on August 3, 2026, that it has issued an amended type certificate and an updated Production Limitation Record for the Boeing 737 MAX-7. This approval comes after nearly a decade of extensive review, during which the regulatory body worked to resolve complex technical issues and conduct a thorough analysis of the aircraft's design. The newly issued certificate confirms that the aircraft complies with all applicable safety and design requirements, while the updated record formally authorizes Boeing to begin production of the variant.

Before granting the certification, the FAA mandated that the Boeing 737 MAX-7 incorporate several critical design improvements. These enhancements address requirements established under the Aircraft Certification, Safety, and Accountability Act, as well as recommendations from the National Transportation Safety Board (NTSB). Specifically, the aircraft underwent updates to its flight-control software and flightcrew alerting system, alongside a redesigned engine anti-ice system. These design changes are intended to provide pilots with clearer alerts and prevent the engine inlet from overheating, which could otherwise weaken the surrounding structure.

Even as production is authorized to begin, the regulatory agency emphasized that safety oversight will remain stringent. The FAA stated that its safety inspectors will continue to be stationed on site at Boeing's manufacturing facilities across the nation. These inspectors will closely monitor the production process, while observing and assessing the implementation of Boeing's Safety Management System (SMS) and broader safety culture.

According to previous reports from Simple Flying, the 737 MAX-7 and the larger MAX-10 represent the final two variants of the Boeing 737 MAX family that were awaiting official certification. The milestone is particularly critical for airline customers like Southwest Airlines, whose business model has traditionally relied on a single aircraft type. The approval of the MAX-7 clears a major regulatory hurdle, paving the way for eventual airline deliveries and the modernization of carrier fleets.

en.title: Two Killed in Mid-Air Collision of Firefighting Helicopters in Greece
en.summary: Two crew members were killed and two others sustained minor injuries on August 3, 2026, after two Bell firefighting helicopters collided mid-air near Psatha in Greece's Attica region. The aircraft were owned by Australian firm McDermott Aviation and leased for wildfire operations. Following the collision, Greek civil protection authorities grounded all Bell helicopters in the country as a precautionary measure, while McDermott Aviation confirmed it is cooperating with ongoing investigations into the cause of the accident.
body: Two firefighting helicopters collided mid-air in Greece's Attica region on August 3, 2026, while battling wildfires approximately 65 kilometers west of Athens. The collision resulted in the deaths of a Danish pilot and a Greek fire service liaison officer aboard one aircraft, while a British pilot and a Greek coordinator on the second helicopter survived with minor injuries.

Both Bell helicopters were owned by Australian company McDermott Aviation, which leases firefighting aircraft internationally. Following the accident, Greek civil protection authorities grounded all Bell helicopters operating in the country as a precaution. McDermott Aviation expressed condolences and confirmed it is cooperating fully with Greek investigators to determine the cause of the crash.

zh.title: 馬來西亞民航局針對馬航機師涉毒案展開安檢程序調查
zh.summary: 馬來西亞民航局於8月2日宣布，針對吉隆坡國際機場的安檢程序展開監管調查。此調查起因於馬來西亞航空一名執飛MH727航班的機師，於7月28日在印尼雅加達因涉嫌走私約25公斤毒品遭扣留。馬來西亞警方亦於8月1日證實展開平行刑事調查，調閱安檢紀錄與監視器畫面。
body: 馬來西亞民航局（CAAM）於2026年8月2日宣布，已對吉隆坡國際機場的航空安全程序啟動監管調查。這項審查將評估航空公司是否完全符合航空安全法規，並檢視班機從馬來西亞起飛之前所執行的機場安全檢查程序，以確認機師離境前是否切實遵守所有安全要求。
該起事件始於2026年7月28日，印尼海關人員在由吉隆坡飛抵雅加達蘇凱諾-哈達國際機場的馬來西亞航空MH727航班降落後，扣留了一名馬來西亞航空機師。印尼當局指控，在該名機師的隨身行李中查獲隱藏的約25公斤搖頭丸與冰毒，數量相當於超過7萬粒膠囊，估算街頭價值約為1050萬美元。
馬來西亞警方於8月1日證實已展開平行的刑事調查，正調閱吉隆坡國際機場的監視器畫面與行李安檢紀錄，並與印尼當局密切合作。調查人員同時正在排查該起案件是否與更廣泛的跨國販毒集團有關，以及航空航線是否遭到走私運作利用。
馬來西亞民航局執行長Norazman Mahmud表示，監管單位的審查旨在確定飛機起飛前是否遵循了所有適用的安全措施。他強調機組人員並未獲得機場安全檢查的豁免權，進入安全管制區域時，必須依據2019年馬來西亞民航安全法規與國家民航安全計畫，與其他人一樣接受手提行李及個人物品的X光檢查等安檢程序。
馬來西亞民航局補充說明，目前正在收集相關證據，若確認有任何違反航空法規或安全要求的行為，將在其管轄權範圍內採取適當的執法行動。馬來西亞航空則表示，公司正全力配合印尼當局的調查，同時正同步進行內部審查程序。

en.title: Malaysia CAAM Probes Airport Security After Pilot Arrested for Drug Smuggling
en.summary: Malaysia's Civil Aviation Authority (CAAM) launched a regulatory investigation on August 2 into airport security procedures at Kuala Lumpur International Airport following the arrest of a Malaysia Airlines pilot in Indonesia. The pilot was detained by Indonesian customs officers on July 28 after flight MH727 arrived at Jakarta’s Soekarno-Hatta International Airport, where authorities allegedly found approximately 25 kilograms of ecstasy and methamphetamine hidden in luggage. Malaysian police confirmed on August 1 that they have opened a parallel criminal probe, reviewing CCTV footage and airport screening records.
body: Malaysia’s Civil Aviation Authority (CAAM) announced on August 2 that it has opened a regulatory investigation into airport security procedures following the arrest of a Malaysia Airlines pilot in Indonesia on alleged drug smuggling charges. The regulator said the probe will examine whether all aviation security requirements were fully complied with before the pilot departed Kuala Lumpur International Airport (KLIA), assessing airline compliance as well as airport screening procedures.

The investigation follows an incident on July 28, 2026, when Indonesian customs officers detained the Malaysia Airlines pilot after the arrival of flight MH727 from Kuala Lumpur (KUL) at Jakarta’s Soekarno-Hatta International Airport (CGK). Indonesian authorities allege they discovered approximately 25 kilograms of ecstasy pills and methamphetamine, equivalent to more than 70,000 capsules, concealed in the pilot’s luggage, with an estimated street value of around $10.5 million.

On August 1, Malaysian police confirmed that they had launched a parallel criminal investigation. Investigators are reviewing CCTV footage and baggage screening records at KLIA while cooperating with Indonesian authorities. Police are also examining whether the case is connected to a wider cross-border drug trafficking syndicate and if commercial aviation routes were exploited for illicit smuggling operations.

CAAM Chief Executive Datuk Captain Norazman Mahmud stated that the regulatory review will determine whether all applicable security measures were followed prior to the aircraft’s departure. He emphasized that flight crew members are not exempt from airport security screening and must undergo the same security screening as all other individuals entering security-restricted areas, including X-ray inspections of cabin baggage and personal items under Malaysia's Civil Aviation Security Regulations 2019 and the National Civil Aviation Security Program.

The aviation regulator added that it is gathering evidence and will take enforcement action within its jurisdiction if any violations of aviation regulations or security requirements are identified. Malaysia Airlines stated that it is fully cooperating with the Indonesian investigation while conducting its own internal review into the incident.

body: 國防部於8月3日公布最新的共機艦動態，統計自8月2日上午6時起至8月3日上午6時止，共偵獲7艘共艦、3艘公務船以及1架共機在台灣周邊活動。

en.title: Taiwan detects 7 PLAN vessels, 3 official ships, 1 PLA aircraft near its waters
en.summary: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense reported detecting 7 PLA vessels, 3 official ships, and 1 PLA aircraft operating near Taiwan between 6 a.m. Aug. 2 and 6 a.m. Aug. 3. The military responded with task force ships and coastal missile systems.
body: Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense (MND) released the latest PLA activity report on Aug. 3, detailing movements detected between 6 a.m. on Aug. 2 and 6 a.m. on Aug. 3.
During this period, the MND detected 7 People's Liberation Army (PLA) vessels, 3 official ships, and 1 PLA aircraft. The aircraft entered Taiwan's southwestern airspace.
Taiwan's armed forces responded by monitoring the situation and deploying task force ships, aircraft, and coastal missile systems.
The report follows the previous day's figures of 8 PLA vessels, 2 official ships, and 5 PLA aircraft, 3 of which crossed the median line of the Taiwan Strait.

zh.summary: 希臘消防部門表示，兩架參與野火滅火任務的消防直升機發生碰撞事故，造成兩名機組人員死亡，一名英國籍機師倖存。事故原因仍在調查中。
body: 路透社報導，希臘消防部門於8月2日證實，一起涉及消防直升機的事故導致兩人不幸罹難。
英國廣播公司（BBC）隨後報導補充，兩架空中消防滅火直升機在希臘執勤時發生碰撞，事故中有一名英國籍機師生還。
目前，當局尚未公布事故發生的具體地點、時間細節以及涉事直升機的機型與所屬單位。相關調查工作正在進行中。
路透社指出，該消息來源為希臘消防服務官方，明確指出有「兩人死亡」。英國廣播公司則具體說明了兩架直升機相撞的性質，並確認生還者包含一名英國籍飛行員。

en.summary: Greece's fire service said two crew members died in a firefighting helicopter crash, while BBC reports a British pilot survived a collision between two firefighting helicopters.
body: Greece's fire service confirmed that two people died in a crash involving a firefighting helicopter, Reuters reported on August 2.
Further details from the BBC stated that a British pilot survived after two firefighting helicopters collided during operations in Greece.
The specific location, exact time of the incident, aircraft types, and operating agencies have not been disclosed by authorities at this stage. An investigation is expected.

The report from Reuters cited the official fire service announcement confirming the fatalities, while the BBC report highlighted the nature of the collision and the nationality of the surviving pilot.

zh.summary: 巴西行政經濟防禦委員會無條件批准美國航空對藍色航空進行1億美元的投資計畫。美國航空將取得藍色航空8.66%的股權，作為該公司在美國進行第11章重組程序的一環。雙方並計畫擴大代碼共享與哩程計畫合作。
body: 巴西行政經濟防禦委員會（CADE）已無條件批准美國航空對藍色航空（Azul）進行1億美元的投資計畫，認定該交易不太可能對巴西航空市場的競爭造成損害。
此項批准允許美國航空取得藍色航空8.66%的股權，作為藍色航空在美國進行第11章重組程序的一環。美國航空並將獲得指定一名董事會成員與戰略委員會代表的權利。
CADE亦審查了包含擴大代碼共享與哩程計畫合作在內的商業協定，並駁回了Abra Group提出的異議。除非遭到上訴，否則該裁決將成為最終決定。

en.title: Brazil Approves American Airlines $100 Million Investment in Azul
en.summary: Brazil's competition authority, the Administrative Council for Economic Defense (CADE), has approved American Airlines' planned $100 million investment in Azul without conditions. The approval allows American Airlines to acquire an 8.66% equity stake in Azul as part of the Brazilian carrier's Chapter 11 restructuring in the United States. In addition, the deal grants American Airlines the right to appoint one board member and a strategic committee representative. CADE also evaluated planned commercial cooperation between the carriers, including expanded codeshare agreements and reciprocal frequent flyer program benefits, concluding that the transaction is unlikely to harm market competition.
body: Brazil's competition authority, the Administrative Council for Economic Defense (CADE), has cleared American Airlines' planned $100 million investment in Azul without conditions, finding the deal unlikely to harm market competition.

The approval permits American Airlines to obtain an 8.66% equity stake in Azul as part of its Chapter 11 restructuring in the United States. The investment grants American Airlines the right to appoint a board member and a strategic committee representative at Azul.

CADE reviewed proposed commercial cooperation involving expanded codeshare flights, reciprocal frequent flyer benefits, and shared lounges. The competition authority also rejected concerns raised by Abra Group, stating that the transaction will proceed unless appealed.
